audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer read Skill for levels 1 through 6; content layer and packet both read Lux for all five of those rows.
audit.why: Light Binding is 1175 range on a flat 10 seconds, Lucent Singularity 1100 on 10-8s, Prismatic Barrier 1150. Azir's Q is 740 and his soldier line is shorter still. She simply out-ranges the entire early kit and pays less mana to do it, so those rows belong to her until Nashor's lands.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side moved to Lux with all five whys rewritten in the same proposal; win[0..4] already read Lux, so the layers now agree, and ratings tightened to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike on the page carried a number, and Final Spark was described only as 'a huge burst finisher'.
audit.why: Final Spark is 3340 range on 60/50/40s and refreshes Illumination. Her lane spike is not an item — it is level 6 turning a 10-second root into a kill from most of the lane away. Azir's counter-spike is Nashor's, which is why levels 5 and 6 of the chart flip.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and ranges written into breakdown.cooldowns, the phase whys, tradeGood and tradeBad.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly said to 'minion-block' Light Binding without saying why that works, and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Riot's text says Light Binding binds up to two enemy units — it stops at the second thing it touches. Two minions in the path therefore eat the whole cast, which is the concrete version of the advice the page was gesturing at. Her passive charges a target with her damaging spells and her next attack ignites it, so the auto after a spell connects is the damage tell.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now state the two-unit limit and the flat 10-second cooldown; dontsFull[0].d names the Illumination auto as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-one lint findings — MISGENDER across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, two phase whys, wave, trading, three Do's, a Don't title and five report entries; two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets; the empty cooldowns field.
audit.why: Lux is female per champ-data/champ-gender.js. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every field edited here; both bled bullets rewritten to answer their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flag misfire noted, not written to the page.
audit.why: The kit file tags Lux's passive as autoReset, but Riot's description says her next attack ignites the stored energy for bonus damage — that is a proc, not an auto-attack reset. The brief's rule is that the description wins.
audit.corrected: The text calls it a damage proc and a tell, never a reset.
